description: This file provides utility functions for performing stateless (functional) calls on PyTorch neural network modules, including handling tied weights and module reparameterization. It also includes a deprecated wrapper for a previous API.

classes.name: NamedMemberAccessor
classes.description: A utility class for accessing and swapping module parameters and buffers.

methods.name: dict[str,Tensor] _untie_named_tensors_map( module: "torch.nn.Module", parameters_and_buffers: dict[str, Tensor], )
methods.description: Creates a new dictionary of parameters and buffers with tied tensors untied as per the module's tying configuration.

methods.name: _reparametrize_module( module: "torch.nn.Module", parameters_and_buffers: dict[str, Tensor], tie_weights: bool = False, strict: bool = False, stack_weights: bool = False, )
methods.description: Context manager that temporarily reparameters a module with optional weight tying and strictness checks.

methods.name: functional_call( module: "torch.nn.Module", parameters_and_buffers: dict[str, Tensor], args: Any | tuple | None = None, kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None, *, tie_weights: bool = True, strict: bool = False, )
methods.description: Deprecated function to perform a stateless call to a module by replacing its parameters and buffers. Wraps around the internal _functional_call.

methods.name: _functional_call( module: "torch.nn.Module", parameters_and_buffers: dict[str, Tensor], args: Any | tuple | None = None, kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None, *, tie_weights: bool = True, strict: bool = False, )
methods.description: Internal implementation that performs the actual stateless module call, respecting tied weights and handling module constraints.
